'''Olsini Turpo''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who lived in [[Bartyn's Landing]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], she owned and operated the business [[Olsini Turpo, Tailor and Haberdasher]].

==Personality and traits==
Turpo was prone to listen and then gossip about what she had heard.
